nodes.name: Harbor Vale
nodes.summary: Harbor Vale is a coastal city of 240,000 people. Its drinking water is supplied by the Harbor Vale Water Authority, usually called HVWA. In January, HVWA chief executive Tomas Reyes announced a plan to raise household water tariffs by 18 percent to pay for replacing the Kessler Reservoir pipeline, which was built in 1961. Mayor Ilse Varga backed the plan at first. Council member Daniel Oyelaran, who chairs the council's finance committee, opposed the rise and argued that low-income households would carry most of the burden.
